# Weekly roll-up ruling (e2e agentic synthetic)

Tanya (team owner) ruled on how the week's reactions reach people:

> the per-run bundle stays, and on Fridays we add one roll-up of the week —
> what moved, what is still open — instead of asking anyone to scroll back

Tina asked whether the roll-up replaces the per-run bundle. Tanya held that it
does not: the bundle is for the run, the roll-up is for the week. Rejected: a
daily digest, because most days carry a single run and it would repeat the
bundle word for word.

payload.rationale: I covered the decision-capture and decisions-evaporate narratives, plus the related core-feature and anti-real-time-chat positions, because the ruling distinguishes durable run-level artifacts from a weekly recap and explicitly avoids making people scroll back. I also included the context-preservation position and the broader anti-Slack narrative as plausible neighboring frames for linking decisions to discussion and preventing lost context; the Sprint 4 thesis position is relevant to persistent decision records. I checked the map's document and people doors: only older product-vision and Sprint 4 material appears, and no People area is available; I did not expand pricing, integration, or webhook positions because they do not bear on this cadence and recap ruling.
